# Test ex with selector expressions and implicit pointer derefs
ex {
	import "bytes"
	var b *bytes.Buffer
	b.Len() -> b.Cap()
}
-- x.go --
package m

import "bytes"

func F(b bytes.Buffer) int {
	return b.Len()
}

func G(b *bytes.Buffer) int {
	return b.Len()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,9 +3,9 @@
 import "bytes"

 func F(b bytes.Buffer) int {
-	return b.Len()
+	return b.Cap()
 }

 func G(b *bytes.Buffer) int {
-	return b.Len()
+	return b.Cap()
 }
